_comment: Minimum % of cases where every check passes. Set just under the 26 Nov 2026 baseline (gpt-5.4-mini: triage 100, confirm 100, draft 100 on rule checks) so one flaky case doesn't block a PR, but a real regression does. Only raise these. The groundedness judge scores 69% on its own labelled set so far, so its verdict on drafts is advisory (judge_gates_drafts: false) until it is reliable enough to gate.
